per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to source-supported membrane interaction/permeabilization and SEM morphology evidence, plus toxicity context; no unsupported intracellular target, exact figure-only value, or supplement-only number was fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review: The previous framework-test-only status is replaced with a source-reviewed worker-6 adjudication. Remaining limitations are nonblocking cautions and no open rework targets remain.

caution_findings.finding: Table 3 supports McCoy viability percentages and treatment at 4× MIC; linked database cytotoxicity rows report exact concentration values that are not standalone primary-table values, so those rows remain source_conflict while the source-supported toxicity values are retained.
CAMP rows compress the primary Table 2 MIC matrix and Table 3 toxicity text into entry-level strings; final activity rows use primary table rows, not the compressed database strings.

Supplementary figures S2-S6 were checked as local PDF text and image/caption material; exact LDH or fluorescence figure values were not tabulated locally, so final claims stay qualitative or table-backed.
PI and SEM support membrane integrity disruption/permeabilization; final curation does not claim a specific intracellular target or pore stoichiometry.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review recovered the missing Table 3 toxicity matrix, rebuilt linked database adjudication, bounded mechanism claims to local evidence, and closes rwk-complete-test-0001 as accepted_with_cautions rather than clean acceptance.
